children: Demand for euro-denominated corporate bonds has been strong in recent years, encouraging companies to issue more bonds, LBBW's Matthias Schell says in a note. In 2025, companies supplied 543 billion euros ($630.5 billion) in new euro corporate bonds, a record level, Schell says. "This year, too, the volume of new issuances is on track to set a record, supported by continued strong demand for corporate bonds." (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
